column1: # BIAB skills manifest — which bundled skills install by default.
#   core     → installed on every box during scaffold and synced on `biab update`.
#   optional → shipped in the repo but NOT installed by default;
#              the user opts in with `biab add <skill-or-group>`.
#   group    → optional 3rd column grouping related skills (e.g. handover, marketing).
# Override for testing/maintenance: BIB_INSTALL_SKILLS=all installs everything.
